缺陷 B25 · P1 · 已知

养老院 dashboard 把所有住户都算进去（22 个，应为 19 个 In Today），取消 In Today 的住户还在上面

票：TFA-92587 AC6 ready for qa；TFA-92598 in progress · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-09/S09, TC-20/S04a, TC-20/S07

思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S06 「状态 × 模式 → 格子，包括老的状态和 Note Ready」 Status × care setting → bucket, including the legacy and Note Ready states

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T3 The app counts every patient in Total and in exactly one of Pending (not yet prepped), In Progress and Complete, and shows the counts prominently（TFA-92598 How it works 1；TFA-92598 How it works 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Seeded: one Hospital patient for each of pending, pre-rounded, in-encounter, seen, note-ready, post-rounded; one Nursing Home resident (In Today) for each of pending, pre-rounded, in-encounter, note-ready, complete

When Open each care setting's dashboard

Then Every patient lands in exactly one bucket: Total = Pending + In Progress + Complete. Only 'pending' is Pending. Pre-rounded, in-encounter and seen are In Progress. Post-rounded and complete are Complete. Note Ready is recorded and judged after Q1

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Ticket rule 1 (every patient counted once; Pending = not yet prepped). counts Total 6 / Pending 1 (Hospital) and Total 5 / Pending 1 (Nursing Home) exact; tiles must add up to Total. In Progress is 3 or 4 and Complete is 1 or 2 depending on Q1: record both, judge after Q1. The prototype's own rule leaves Seen and Note Ready in no bucket, which fails the sum

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S06 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev + 本地 · 票 TFA-92598 in progress；TFA-92587 ready for qa

养老院 dashboard 四个格子都按全部住户算，不按今天的 In Today 名单算，每个数都偏大。

All four Nursing Home dashboard tiles (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) are counted over every resident instead of today's In Today list, so every number is too high.

依据：allure-results/440f2963…: NH buckets got 22/7/9/6, expected 19/6/(8/5 or 6/7). dev and 本地 datasets are identical. Same root as S04a (counts taken over All Residents). Where Note Ready lands is only recorded (TC-20 Q1: Note Ready counted In Progress).

重复：和 TC-20/S04a 是同一个问题，看那条（保留的）；这条带标签「重复」，筛选时可以去掉。
